en: A vintage monochrome postcard with a decorative floral border framing a panoramic photograph. The image shows a view over a city landscape with fields and buildings in the distance and, in the foreground, a large historic complex with towers and pitched roofs surrounded by trees. The caption at the top reads "Blick von Eggenberg." and at the bottom "Graz." Publisher information is printed vertically along the left margin.
